name: Flinders Community Market (free food)
summary: Free fruit, vegetables and bread plus low-cost pantry items for all Flinders students every Thursday in semester.
who: A community market for all students
how: No need to register or book, just turn up to the Oasis Common Room (J7) on Thursdays 11 AM to 1 PM
catches: Closes during the mid-year and end-year breaks
